description: This file defines interfaces for the IOcdm and IOcdmFactory classes, which are part of the Rialto server's media DRM support. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to media key system support.

classes.name: IOcdm
classes.description: Interface for a DRM system, providing a method to check if a key system is supported.

classes.name: IOcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving singleton instances of IOcdm.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm singleton object.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system is supported by the DRM system.
